connector.name: Laddro Career
connector.registryDescription: Tailor resumes, generate cover letters, render CVs as PDF, and browse 22+ templates.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.laddro.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package career-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.laddro, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer token using your Laddro Career API key from console.laddro.com
